mapper.sql: select workspace_id, database_storage_id, owner_uid, created_at, workspace_type, deleted_at, workspace_name, icon, settings, is_initialized, default_published_view_id from af_workspace

select workspace_id, owner_uid, workspace_name, member_count, member_ids, af_collab_count, af_collab_ids, af_invitation_count, af_invitation_ids, af_user_subscriptions_ids, start_date, end_date from af_user_workspace
mapper.insert: insert into af_workspace (workspace_id, database_storage_id, owner_uid, created_at, workspace_type, deleted_at, workspace_name, icon, settings, is_initialized, default_published_view_id) values(#{workspaceId}, #{databaseStorageId}, #{ownerUid}, #{createdAt}, #{workspaceType}, #{deletedAt}, #{workspaceName}, #{icon}, #{settings}, #{isInitialized}, #{default_published_view_id})
mapper.update:
update af_workspace
database_storage_id = #{databaseStorageId},
owner_uid = #{ownerUid},
workspace_type = #{workspaceType},
deleted_at = #{deletedAt},
workspace_name = #{workspaceName},
icon = #{icon},
settings = #{settings},
is_initialized = #{isInitialized},
default_published_view_id = #{default_published_view_id},
where workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

mapper.select: SELECT w.workspace_id, w.owner_uid, w.workspace_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.uid) AS member_count, COALESCE(array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT m.uid), ','), '') AS member_ids, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ac.oid) > 0 THEN CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ac.oid) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '不限' END AS af_collab_count, COALESCE(array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT ac.oid), ','), '') AS af_collab_ids, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) > 0 THEN CONCAT(COUNT(DISTINCT i.id), '/10') -- 假设上限为10，可替换为实际配置 ELSE '无权限' END AS af_invitation_count, COALESCE(array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT i.id), ','), '') AS af_invitation_ids, COALESCE(array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT us.id), ','), '') AS af_user_subscriptions_ids, us_latest.start_date AS start_date, us_latest.end_date AS end_date FROM af_workspace w LEFT JOIN af_workspace_member m ON w.workspace_id = m.workspace_id LEFT JOIN af_workspace_invitation i ON w.workspace_id = i.workspace_id LEFT JOIN af_collab ac ON w.workspace_id = ac.workspace_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT us.uid, us.id, us.start_date, us.end_date FROM af_user_subscriptions us INNER JOIN ( SELECT uid, MAX(end_date) AS max_end_date FROM af_user_subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY uid ) us_max ON us.uid = us_max.uid AND us.end_date = us_max.max_end_date WHERE us.status = 'active' ) us_latest ON w.owner_uid = us_latest.uid LEFT JOIN af_user_subscriptions us ON w.owner_uid = us.uid AND us.status = 'active' where w.owner_uid = #{ownerUid} GROUP BY w.workspace_id, w.owner_uid, w.workspace_name, us_latest.start_date, us_latest.end_date
